title: Andhere Dete Hai
body:
andhere dete hai pehra lehad pe bibi ki
ujaala aa nahi sakta lehad pe bibi ki
<<DIVIDER>>
hussain shaam dhale kehte honge akbar se
chalo chale mere beta lehad pe bibi ki
andhere dete hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
jhukaye rakhna khabardaar apne nazron ko
ke roz aati hai zehra lehad pe bibi ki
andhere dete hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
kahin ye hazrat e abbas to nahi hai dil
ye kaun karta hai girya lehad pe bibi ki
andhere dete hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
har ek shaam ko shamma jalane aati hai
janabe zainab e kubra lehad pe bibi ki
andhere dete hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai koi maa jo ye saydaniyo se kehti hai
rida baghair na aana lehad pe bibi ki
andhere dete hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
khuda karega takallum wo din bhi aayega
padhunga jaake ye nauha lehad pe bibi ki
andhere dete hai...
author: Mir Takallum
